theme.referenceNotes: Design direction: app UI is dark Material 3 with an indigo primary and a glowing lavender burn ring, so the deck is its calm inverse — a light lilac mist that makes the dark phones pop, with one memorable motif: a thin ring echoing the burn ring. Challenge check: the default finance pick (sage-mist green) would fight the violet UI, so switched the temperature axis to lilac and set the brand indigo #5B4FE0 as the single accent; highlights on 3 of 7 slides only.
